summary: Add host-owned native composer draft binding, recorded service readiness and cancellable accessible resizable splits.

compatibility.detail: Hosts can bind native composer text with read/write/flush storage and supply recorded service facts on work-log calls. Command errors promote to the inline failure banner only when the host reports a run-ending failure. Reverse splits resize consistently from keyboard and pointer; Escape restores a held drag without committing. Non-resizable tracks have no focusable separator.
